newsitem.title: USA: Roadmaster sees Q4 net about $300,000.
newsitem.headline: Roadmaster sees Q4 net about $300,000.

text.p: Roadmaster Industries Inc said Wednesday it expects to report a profit of about $300,000 for the fourth quarter of 1996.

Roadmaster said in a release that initiatives made during the second and third quarters of 1996, particularly in the DP Fitness unit, have "significantly improved the Company's operating results" in the quarter ended December 31, 1996.
For the fourth quarter, the DP Fitness unit reported operating income of about $3.8 million, compared with an operating loss of about $15 million in the same period in 1995.
Roadmaster reported a net loss of $41.7 million, or $0.85 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995. The loss was reported after charges and special costs of about $50.5 million before taxes.
